facts.fact: Winter 自拒绝命定伴侣 Talia 后流连妓院
facts.anchor: Winter had been visiting the brothels ever since he rejected his mate, Talia

facts.fact: 八年前那个人类女孩的脸仍萦绕他的梦
facts.anchor: her face haunted his dreams and he woke curious where she’d disappeared to

facts.fact: 他是唯一让她动心过的人，直到发现她的叛徒血统
facts.anchor: the only one he’d ever found himself drawn to until he discovered the traitorous blood running through her veins

facts.fact: 两小时前猎人袭王：杀花园守卫、爬藤入室
facts.anchor: They killed the guards in the garden and climbed up the ivy, breaking into your father’s room

facts.fact: 国王重伤：杀两名袭击者但断臂断腿几乎被开膛
facts.anchor: He managed to kill two of the attackers, but not before they broke his arm, leg, and nearly disemboweled him

facts.fact: Micah 是原班狼群中未被 Red Riding Hood 杀掉的幸存者
facts.anchor: the last of Winter’s original packmates—one of his most hostile wolves—who hadn’t been murdered by Red Riding Hood like so many others

facts.fact: Winter 起意往药里掺 wolfsbane 伪装意外
facts.anchor: perhaps Winter could slip wolfsbane into one of the concoctions… Make it look like an accident

facts.fact: 国王命 Winter 摄政直到痊愈，令其自证
facts.anchor: You’ll rule in my stead until I’m well again. Prove yourself
